text: Server-side import file selection must be confined to a configured directory without traversal or symlink escape; see FR-IOX-048.
Only declared registry options accepted from requests; validate against schema instead of PHP POST allow-list.
Need to HTML-escape transformed values stays; realise via framework escaping, and render raw HTML only in a sandboxed iframe.
Keep signed row addressing, clamped image sizes, sanitized links with noopener; implement in Node endpoint, not PHP wrapper controller.
Keep user-controlled tree behaviours (sync with page, highlight, auto-expand) as settings; no CSS-class mechanism required.
Keep resizable and collapsible navigation panel with persisted width, RTL-aware; store in user preferences.
Preferences persist per account on server; browser storage only for per-viewer conveniences, no import/delete detection UI.
Keep consistent shell with navigation, top bar, content area and sidebar; built with React layout, not Twig.
Keep lang and dir set from active interface language; set by app root.
Keep viewport, noindex, same-origin referrer policy and cache-busted assets; jQuery-UI and CodeMirror CSS dropped.
Keep navigation excluded from print and persisted width; mechanism is frontend state.
Keep home, logout, docs links (MySQL vs MariaDB aware) and reload tree; LegacyAdmin logo/docs and config-auth wording dropped.
Show connection/profile switcher based on available connection profiles rather than configured server list.
Keep a visible error state with retry when tree fails to load.
Keep tabbed top menu with active marker and accessible collapse on small screens; Bootstrap 5 not mandated.
Keep a home dashboard with connection, server status and general settings; demo notice, themes list and collation select as decided.
Keep cancelling superseded navigation requests and preventing duplicate form submissions with a progress indicator.
Keep clear error display and highlighting of the offending field; server redirects handled by router.
Keep warning before leaving a form with unsaved changes, including SQL editor content; implement via router blocker.
Keep re-login in place without losing work when session expires; token handling per DBLoom security design.
Keep working back/forward and deep-linkable URLs via router; no manual popstate handling.
Keep readable error with status and connection hint for network or server failures.
Keep toast/notification system with loading, success, error types and auto-dismiss; exact timeouts and jQuery API not required.
Confirmation dialog before ruinous operations remains; use accessible modal, not jQuery-UI dialog.
Keep per-page settings dialog with apply and cancel restoring state; dimensions free.
Keep keyboard shortcuts with input-field suppression rules; Ctrl+K command palette is the primary entry point.
Ctrl+Arrow movement between fields in insert and column grids is useful productivity behaviour.
Modifier-click to remove or add columns in multi-column ORDER BY stays.
Shift-click range selection of rows stays.
Keep lazy-loaded tree with persisted expand/filter state, but via TanStack server functions and client storage, not /navigation POST and PHP token keys.
Per-database and per-table live substring filter in the tree is useful.
Keep collapse-all, reload, and highlighting current db/table; drop jQuery/CommonParams mechanics.
Hiding tree items and an unhide dialog is a feature choice; owner decides. (owner decision 2026-10-23, feature: hidden nav items)
Keep top navigation overflowing into a menu on narrow widths using modern CSS/React, not menuResizer plugin.
Keep usable mobile layout for the tree; reimplement without jQuery breakpoints code.
Second review (Haiku, 10 reviewers, 2026-10-23): no separate console; history and bookmarks move into the SQL editor (UI-TGT-001).
If console exists, options go through DBLoom settings/user preferences, not config get via JS.
Resizable, reorderable, hideable result columns are useful.
Keep column reorder and in-place cell editing; reimplement in React, no copy/pointer DOM hacks.
Check-all, per-group select, indeterminate state and row highlighting are needed for bulk operations.
Client-side row filtering with live match count is useful.
Row hover/selection highlight stays via design tokens and CSS, not theme SCSS variables.
Keep SQL editor with autocomplete and linting using a modern editor component, not CodeMirror 5 jQuery wiring.
Syntax highlighting of displayed queries is needed.
Keep schema-aware table/column autocomplete; fetch via server functions with caching.
Keep links from keywords to MySQL/MariaDB docs, chosen per product and version via Strategy.
Auto-saving unsent query drafts is useful.
Date and time pickers stay locale-aware via browser Intl/modern components, not server-injected jQuery config.
Keep enum/set editor for cell edits as normal React dialog, not pre-rendered modals.
Keep drag and drop file import with upload status panel, rebuilt in React.
Keep async upload with progress; accepted types follow DBLoom import formats, not the legacy list.
Cancelling in-flight uploads with status feedback is needed.
Keep client-side validation of settings forms, using schema validation per 12-settings.md.
Keep strength meter on password forms for DBLoom accounts and MySQL users; reimplement.
Keep correct text direction per locale if RTL languages are shipped; implement with CSS logical properties.
Direction-aware layout stays, derived from document dir, using CSS logical properties.
Keep no-password toggle, password generation, confirmations in DBLoom user management UI.
Keep keyboard shortcuts but centered on Ctrl+K palette; drop key-code handling and console toggles.
Keep selectable UI languages with browser-language fallback; no gettext .mo files or LegacyAdmin language table.
Keep contextual help links to DBLoom and MySQL/MariaDB docs; no url.php or local LegacyAdmin manual.
Keep responsive behaviour and print hiding; implemented with modern CSS, not Bootstrap 5 classes.
Support current evergreen browsers; define the matrix explicitly; no Bootstrap 5.3.8 or cookie requirement as such.
Keep a simple print stylesheet hiding chrome for result and structure views; no SCSS partial.
Keep ARIA and keyboard accessibility; set explicit WCAG target and automated checks instead of open decision.
Use CSP frame-ancestors and X-Frame-Options headers, not JS frame busting.
Use noopener noreferrer on external links.
Suppress indexing with noindex and X-Robots-Tag; translation metas optional.
Keep idle-timeout warning and expiry handling in UI, driven by DBLoom session settings; no PHP gc or cookie validity.
Keep RTL support, derive direction from locale script so regional codes like ar_LY work.
Show own licence and third-party notices in an About page; no /license or /changelog routes.
Keep contextual links to MySQL and MariaDB manuals for supported versions; no local doc/html or url.php redirect.
DBLoom keeps its own app store; per-feature tables (bookmarks, history etc.) follow feature decisions, not the legacyadmin database.
Column transformations feature scope is an owner decision; plugin generator scripts dropped. (owner decision 2026-10-23, feature: column transformations)
Keep idempotent, forward-only schema migrations for DBLoom's own store, via migration tool not SQL scripts.
Keep a single authoritative app version surfaced in UI; PHP Version class, ChangeLog and script mechanics dropped.
Enforce minimum MySQL 8.4 / MariaDB 10.11 (proposed) instead of 5.5; refuse older servers with clear error.
Show only plugins valid on minimum servers (caching_sha2, sha256, unix_socket, ed25519 etc.); drop mysql_old_password and native-only assumptions.
Require a current evergreen browser with JavaScript; no cookie-only or Bootstrap 5.3.8 pin.
First-run setup in DBLoom via settings/.env (12-settings.md); no config.inc.php generator or download-and-upload flow.
Keep upgrade path and optional update notification (owner may disable for air-gapped); PHP file replacement mechanics dropped.
Hashed build assets invalidate stale client state automatically; version query strings and PHP shims dropped.
TLS connections to the DB server with CA, cert, key, verify options remain required; adapt to Node driver options.
Run on Linux and Windows (and containers) via Node; PMA_IS_WINDOWS and PHP permission checks dropped.
Keep base URL override, X-Forwarded-Proto and trusted-proxy client IP handling as settings in 12-settings.md.
Keep restrictive permissions on secrets/settings and writable data dir; PHP config.inc.php check and TempDir mechanics dropped.
Ensure no source, settings or temp files are web-served; handled by app architecture and container, not .htaccess.
Serve robots.txt disallowing all crawlers; trivial for a self-hosted admin tool.
Publish checksums and signed releases/images for DBLoom artifacts; GPG details and LegacyAdmin keys dropped.
Keep logging of login success/denial with user and IP for fail2ban-style use; emit via Node logger/stdout, configured in settings.
Keep optional IP allow/deny and rejecting root/empty-password logins as DBLoom settings, not AllowDeny config arrays.
Keep CSRF defence for state-changing requests, using TanStack Start/Node mechanisms (SameSite, origin check, token), regenerate session at login.
